checks.detail: missing=[]
one retained exact listener capability cannot be copied
scope does not silently close the caller-owned listening descriptor
non-owned TLS and authorization dependencies cannot mutate under the session
accept, authentication, request, receipt, and success are not collapsed
transport close cannot rewrite application settlement
descriptor number alone cannot mint accept authority
moved-from local misuse throws while an inherited active capability still fail-stops
SO_ACCEPTCONN cannot be borrowed from a replacement descriptor
no post-accept flag race or leaked child exists on exceptions
queued-child creation cannot bypass listener identity or cutpoint
peer/network transients do not become fatal listener corruption
no OpenSSL operation interposes between SSL_accept and classification
other SSL outcomes terminate without speculative replay
SSL cannot inherit an unproved blocking or exec-inheritable child
certificate validity alone never authorizes an actor or request
the outer socket/SSL lifecycle composes the inner one-run application owner
timeout and unmapped peer return before receiver-session composition
remote authentication failure is typed while local allocation failure propagates
cleanup reproof/poll failure becomes subordinate diagnostic state
OpenSSL fast-shutdown return zero remains a non-error terminal state
one-shot close never blocks outside the absolute shutdown cutpoint
exceptional and terminal paths cannot leak or double-close after EINTR
server code does not duplicate descriptor-flag authority syscalls
interruptions and spurious results cannot fabricate readiness
compiled tests exercise no-mutation and complete publication paths
the shared leaf is tested independently from TLS composition
ordinary builds and CTest include the accepted-session surface
a sealed handoff cannot omit implementation, poll leaf, or audit
source vocabulary is not represented as runtime proof

scope_nonclaim: source vocabulary and order do not prove kernel, OpenSSL, membership, timeout, SQLite, or filesystem semantics
